method.zone_membership: area ID of the ADT MCNK terrain chunk under each spawn (WoW 1.12.1 MPQs); for spawns more than underground_yd below the terrain, the area of the enclosing WMO placement (WMOAreaTable root row) when there is one; that area's AreaTable.dbc parent (zone) == 46. WMO areas on another map are ignored
method.camp_rule: single-linkage cluster of spawns sharing faction_template and creature type, within camp_link_yd in 2D and 15 yd in Z; clusters wider than camp_max_radius_yd split by recursive 2-means
method.reaction: vmangos FactionTemplateEntry::IsHostileTo/IsFriendlyTo against the 8 player race faction templates, plus base reputation
